draft_en.subject: The industrial PoE switches you source - three configurations, from single units
draft_en.body:
Hi Jehad,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 28 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial PoE switches you source, three configurations from single units, -40 to 75 C, FCC/CE/RoHS, EXW, 15-day validity: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $82.2 USD; the same unmanaged - STI-288GP - $60; 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 1 x Gigabit + 1 x SFP, unmanaged - STI-154GP - $39.2. Shenzhen side: you have a China number, so a visit to see units is easy to arrange.

One question: which configuration do your current projects need - and managed or unmanaged?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
